svg.title: Project 6 of 6: Purchase-Planner. A 30-day purchase plan for the 24 suppliers of Lumo, the shop from Data-Generator, with a reason on every line and an Excel order per supplier. Replayed on all of 2024, it serves 97.2% of demand (the buyer ordering by eye 93.0%) with 12% less stock on average. Methods: Poisson regression, TSB forecast, order-up-to policy, stock budget, backtest. Stack: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Dash, Plotly. Animated preview: its web app (Dash) at work. The 2024 backtest (97.2% of demand served, 917k PLN less stock than the shop's buyer), then the page scrolls to the plan of the largest supplier with a reason on every line, a click downloads its Excel order, then the chart of one product with its stock, forecast and planned deliveries, then back to the top. Link below the card: View project.
